Coca-Cola Cake 🥤🍫 This old-fashioned Coca-Cola Cake is rich, incredibly moist, and covered with a warm chocolate frosting that melts right into the cake. Mini marshmallows bake into the batter, giving this nostalgic 9×13 cake an extra-soft texture. You can get the more detailed version with extra tips, step-by-step help, and a printable recipe on my website. Visit my blog through the link in my bio! For the cake: 2 cups all-purpose flour 2 cups granulated sugar ½ teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 cup Coca-Cola 1 cup salted butter ⅓ cup unsweetened cocoa powder ½ cup buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup mini marshmallows For the frosting: ½ cup salted butter 3 Tablespoons unsweetened cocoa powder 6 Tablespoons Coca-Cola 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3¾ cups powdered sugar 1 cup chopped pecans or walnuts, optional Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish. Whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and baking soda in a large bowl. In a saucepan over medium heat, combine the Coca-Cola, butter, and cocoa powder. Heat until the butter melts and the mixture just begins to simmer, whisking occasionally. Pour the hot cocoa mixture into the dry ingredients and whisk until combined. Add the buttermilk, eggs, and vanilla, stirring just until smooth. Fold in the mini marshmallows. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish and bake for 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out with a few moist crumbs. About five minutes before the cake finishes baking, melt the butter with the cocoa powder and Coca-Cola in a saucepan over medium heat. Remove it from the heat and whisk in the vanilla and powdered sugar until smooth. Stir in the nuts, if using. Pour the warm frosting over the warm cake and spread it evenly. Let the frosting set before slicing. #cocacolacake #chocolatecake #southerndessert #oldfashionedrecipes #cakerecipe Coca-Cola cake recipe, old-fashioned Coca-Cola cake, Southern chocolate cake, chocolate sheet cake, 9×13 cake recipe, chocolate cake with warm frosting, nostalgic dessert recipe

Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

O tempo de forno é aproximadamente 40 minutos. Desenforme o bolo morno. Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie

🚨 SAVE THIS ONE! 🚨 The easiest 3 INGREDIENT LAVA CAKE and it’s dangerously good 🤤 You need: 🍫 1 box chocolate cake mix 🥤 1 can (12 oz) soda 🍫 1 tub chocolate frosting Mix the cake mix and soda right in your Deep Covered Baker aka the MAGIC POT. Drop spoonfuls of chocolate frosting all over the top. Microwave on HIGH for about 9 to 10 minutes. Let it sit for about 5 minutes and THAT’S IT. The frosting melts down into the cake and creates all that warm, gooey chocolate lava 😍 Add vanilla ice cream on top and thank me later. SAVE this recipe because you’re going to make it again!
